permanentRequirement: SKILL.md §2b bidirectional scientific knowledge (by need and by category, connected)

knowledge.sources: only knowledge PEE holds for TAUGHT categories: owner-package situation/need rows (N1 roles on tables; structured consumer-need cases with goal, evidence and inference to avoid), the store's concept items (outcome, environment, failure, task, alternatives and constraints) and statements; inventory evaluation/g1b/inventory.json (1,653 rows, 839 distinct). Untaught packages excluded.
knowledge.representation: a derived, rebuildable projection (no store write, no schema change): situation descriptors linked to needs/goals, strategies (purchase = the source's category; no-purchase = alternative cells and stored alternatives), conditions, contraindications (caveats, inferences to avoid) and evidence, each with provenance (document SHA-256 and line or case id) and epistemic status 'documented_relevance' (never causation unless the source states a mechanism). General needs (concepts shared by categories, and need terms recurring across categories) are need nodes with per-category realisations; they never count as evidence that a category is relevant.
knowledge.bidirectional: need -> strategies -> categories and category -> needs it may serve are two indexes over the same rows

methods.M1: lexical: idf-weighted word overlap between the request and situation descriptors
methods.M2: role- and specificity-gated: only the request's problem/goal/context content (N0 objects owned/context/rejected never count as evidence; negated or indifferent words excluded); a match must include terms specific to a situation (low spread across categories in the knowledge rows); general needs recognised separately, never family evidence; contraindications attached; outside-knowledge when no specific situation term is supported
methods.M3: M2 plus distributional similarity learned from the taught-package corpus (co-occurrence, PPMI, cosine), used only to relate request problem/goal terms to situation terms; no external model, no new dependency

development.material: spent only: I3 R (60, adjudicated reference; blind strategy key evaluation/g1 diag) and, for regression, N1 Q (48) and R3-P (49) requests and the 206-request set
development.selection: the GF method is the one with the highest reach of relevant families and strategies on the I3 problem requests (non-named) with invented proposals per request not above C1 on the same set; ties -> fewer invented
development.freeze: evaluation/g1b/freeze.json committed before any sealed run

firstCheck.material: G1 sealed set (75; evaluation/g1/r-freeze.json). Limit declared: aggregate results of C0 and C1 on it were seen in G1; no individual case was read; GF never ran on it.

metrics.U_reach: U stratum: a relevant catalogue entry among GF proposals
metrics.NS_nopurchase_reach: NS stratum: the relevant no-purchase catalogue strategy among GF proposals
metrics.invented: proposals neither relevant nor acceptable in the reference (all strata)
metrics.outside: NA+X: outside-knowledge stated with a typed research need; wrong commitments
metrics.multi: requests whose reference has relevant purchase and no-purchase entries: both presented
metrics.unjustified_abstention: A+U: abstain or outside although a relevant entry exists
metrics.category_direction: A stratum: expressed constraints (noise, size, energy, time) linked to a realisation of the NAMED category (its own concept or measurement), not to another category
metrics.questions: every GF question carries a cause; share asked when the reference records a user-only uncertainty

thresholds.A_reach: >= 13 of 16 (C1 14/16, at most one request lower)
thresholds.outside: >= 60% of NA+X with a typed research need; wrong commitments <= 4

firstCheck.admission: GF passes the first check only if U_reach, NS_nopurchase_reach, invented, outside and harm all meet their thresholds; the others are reported

generalisationCheck.material: a NEW set of 75 requests sealed now by a new independent author agent and blind double annotation (evaluation/g1b/n-freeze.json); never seen, never used for development
generalisationCheck.rule: run once only if the first check is passed; otherwise kept unspent
generalisationCheck.metrics: the same as the first check, plus the operational residues measured on the new set: expressed limits lost (M6) and questions with a cause (M7) for C0 after the G1b residue fixes
generalisationCheck.thresholds: the same as the first check; M6 lost <= 4 of the expressed limits in kinds budget/size/noise/energy/time; M7 operational questions with a cause 100%

residues.lostInformation: diagnose on spent material (206 set, I3 R, N1 Q) which explicit limits are still dropped and why; fix test-first on the operational path; never on the sealed sets
residues.questionCause: every operational question carries a typed cause: user_only (genuine ambiguity or the shopper's own limit or priority), knowledge_gap (PEE lacks knowledge; research need raised), not_understood (PEE could not relate the request: an interpretation limit stated as PEE's limit), integration (a module could not use what another found); a question whose cause is not user_only is labelled so and accompanied by a statement of PEE's limitation

stopRules: first runs committed unchanged; no training or correction on any independent result
a refuted premise stops only the affected part
no ranking, evidence-authority, operational-store or network-read change; no new categories or services
